headline: Can Gulf states and Iran negotiate the Strait of Hormuz without the U.S.?
context: Dania Thafer of the Gulf International Forum weighs in on previously scheduled talks between Iran and Gulf states. Shortly before this interview aired, Oman announced that the talks were postponed.
